summary: ATS Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the timing of its fourth quarter fiscal 2026 earnings release and conference call, scheduled for May 28, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings notification with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The document simply provides instructions for accessing the earnings webcast and conference call, along with boilerplate corporate information. This is an ordinary communication from a foreign private issuer.
